tools.name: freightsimple_list_carriers
tools.description: List the carriers available to this company, with their identifiers. GET /v1/carriers/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_list_distribution_warehouse_brands
tools.description: List the distribution warehouse brands (for example Amazon sites) FreightSimple recognises, and whether each needs a delivery deadline. GET /v1/distribution-warehouse-brands/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_list_dangerous_goods
tools.description: Look up dangerous goods reference data (UN numbers, classes, packing groups). The optional search text filters on UN number, class, proper shipping name or description. GET /v1/dangerous-goods/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_get_shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment: its status, the quotes (when quoted), the selected quote, documents and tracking history. Give exactly one of shipment_id or tracking_id. Poll this after start_quoting until shipmentStatus is Quoted. GET /v1/shipments/get-shipment.

tools.name: freightsimple_list_saved_commodities
tools.description: List the saved commodities (reusable product definitions) of this company. GET /v1/saved-commodities/list.

tools.name: freightsimple_get_saved_commodity_by_sku
tools.description: Get one saved commodity by its SKU identifier. GET /v1/saved-commodities/get-by-sku.

tools.name: freightsimple_start_quoting
tools.description: Create a shipment and start the carrier quoting process (no cost is committed). Returns shipmentId and warnings. Quoting takes about 30 seconds: then poll freightsimple_get_shipment until shipmentStatus is Quoted. A cross-border shipment needs a broker. POST /v1/shipments/start-quoting.

tools.name: freightsimple_start_booking
tools.description: Book a quote from a quoted shipment. This makes a carrier pickup and commits the cost, so confirm must be true. Use the quoteId from get_shipment. Poll get_shipment until shipmentStatus is BookingConfirmed (about 15 seconds). POST /v1/shipments/start-booking.

tools.name: freightsimple_upload_customs_documents
tools.description: Upload customs documents (base64 PDFs, for example the commercial invoice) to a cross-border shipment. Each upload goes straight to the carrier, so confirm must be true. Use mode Replace to swap a corrected set. Upload from BookingConfirmed until delivered. POST /v1/shipments/upload-customs-document

tools.name: freightsimple_create_saved_commodity
tools.description: Save a reusable commodity definition for this company. POST /v1/saved-commodities/create.

tools.name: freightsimple_update_saved_commodity
tools.description: Replace a saved commodity's fields. Send every required field again, not only the changed ones. POST /v1/saved-commodities/update.

tools.name: freightsimple_delete_saved_commodity
tools.description: Delete a saved commodity by id. This cannot be undone. POST /v1/saved-commodities/delete.
